discovery: Discovery of geometric phases in quantum mechanics (the Aharonov-Bohm effect and the Berry phase)
rationale: Recent prizes went to machine learning (2024) and macroscopic quantum tunnelling in superconducting circuits (2025), so the committee may now turn to foundational theory. Geometric phases underpin topological matter, quantum computing and modern condensed-matter physics. Aharonov and Berry are long-standing favourites, both are elderly, and both have collected major prizes such as the Wolf Prize.
